svg.title: A build with branches and returns

g.text: A build with branches and returns
Editorial alternatives → next stop, travel and useful actions.
Parallel design branch · type / controls / colour
Wordmark counters · icon studies · mono and mixed palettes · banana rounds.
Parallel functional branch · map / documents / journal
Map provider change · original file links · draft recovery and receipts.
Ticket branch · early paper → dense experiment ↩ early paper
Current booking facts survive the return; title treatment refined separately.
Bottle Green / Cherry / Yellow / Electric Blue; meal-specific maps.
New sharing scope. Configurable template/editor cancelled; private app preserved.
